    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    A bishop, which slides any distance along diagonals.
    Board
     
    BoardTest
     
    Color
    Represents the two sides in a chess game.
    Game
    Manages chess gameplay and player turns.
    InputValidator
     
    King
    A king, which moves one square in any direction (check and castling are not handled yet).
    Knight
    A knight, which jumps in an L shape and is not blocked by pieces in between.
    Main
     
    Pawn
    A pawn, which moves forward, captures diagonally, and can advance two squares from its starting row.
    Piece
    Base class for all chess pieces; stores color and position and defines how pieces report moves.
    Player
    Creates a class that represents one chess player.
    Position
    A square on the board, stored as a zero-based row and column (A8 = 0,0 and H1 = 7,7).
    Queen
    A queen, which slides any distance along ranks, files, and diagonals.
    Rook
    A rook, which slides any distance along ranks and files.
